about: Footage recipes for the first picture beat: the product's core transformation shown literally (input -> output), with a real person where the input is human. Each input: the shot, its framing, the screen that takes the UI plate built in code, the searches (footage first, then photos) and the picks, clips and photos looked at on a contact sheet and kept. An input without picks carries its searches only: recipe runs them at once. Read with: node scripts/assets.mjs recipe "<input>"; the compositing is in references/imagery.md, "Show the core action".
licences: every pick needs no credit (coverr: the Coverr licence for free clips; mixkit-video: the Mixkit Stock Video Free License; burst: Burst Some Rights Reserved; cc0). get reads each licence again at its source before it downloads.
